checks.name: Attack surface and entry points
checks.objective: Inventory endpoints, roles, trust boundaries and exposed administrative interfaces.

checks.name: Authentication and recovery
checks.objective: Evaluate authentication, account recovery, MFA enrollment and resistance to account abuse.

checks.name: Object and function authorization
checks.objective: Compare role and object access decisions using permitted test accounts.

checks.name: Session and token lifecycle
checks.objective: Review token issuance, expiration, revocation and session boundaries.

checks.name: Untrusted input and output
checks.objective: Assess input handling, injection exposure, file processing and output encoding.

checks.name: Business logic and API limits
checks.objective: Evaluate workflow constraints, abuse cases, race conditions and resource limits.

checks.name: Directory attack surface
checks.objective: Inventory directory services, trust relationships, identity providers and privileged groups.

checks.name: Privilege delegation
checks.objective: Review delegated permissions and paths to privileged identity control.

checks.name: Authentication protocol exposure
checks.objective: Assess legacy authentication, signing, channel binding and credential exposure.

checks.name: Certificate and federation trust
checks.objective: Review certificate enrollment, federation claims and trust configuration.

checks.name: Service identities and secrets
checks.objective: Review identity ownership, credential rotation and access boundaries.

checks.name: Confirmed access and cleanup
checks.objective: Document confirmed access paths and remove engagement-created accounts or changes.

checks.name: Account and tenant boundaries
checks.objective: Record authorized subscriptions, projects, organizations and tenant boundaries.

checks.name: IAM and workload identity
checks.objective: Review trust policies, role assumptions, service identities and least privilege.

checks.name: Storage and data exposure
checks.objective: Evaluate object access, data sharing, encryption configuration and retention.

checks.name: Control plane and network exposure
checks.objective: Review exposed management interfaces, private connectivity and security rules.

checks.name: Logging and detection coverage
checks.objective: Verify agreed security events are logged and can be investigated.

checks.name: SaaS integrations and consent
checks.objective: Review delegated application access, OAuth consent and third-party integrations.

checks.name: Scope and service inventory
checks.objective: Reconcile discovered hosts and services against authorized ranges and exclusions.

checks.name: Service configuration and patching
checks.objective: Validate scanner observations against service versions and configuration evidence.

checks.name: Segmentation and trust boundaries
checks.objective: Test agreed network boundaries and record actual reachability separately from access.

checks.name: Credential exposure and reuse
checks.objective: Assess permitted credential validation and record per-service outcomes.

checks.name: Privilege boundaries
checks.objective: Validate agreed local privilege boundaries with reproducible evidence.

checks.name: Resilience and change cleanup
checks.objective: Confirm restoration steps and verify removal of engagement artifacts.

checks.name: Cluster and registry exposure
checks.objective: Inventory authorized clusters, registries and control-plane endpoints.

checks.name: RBAC and service accounts
checks.objective: Review subject permissions, token use and namespace boundaries.

checks.name: Workload isolation
checks.objective: Assess security contexts, host mounts and workload-to-host trust.

checks.name: Images and software supply chain
checks.objective: Review image provenance, package exposure and release integrity.

checks.name: Secrets and admission policy
checks.objective: Evaluate secret handling and the enforcement of workload admission controls.

checks.name: Storage and sensitive artifacts
checks.objective: Review local data, backups, logs and sensitive material retained by the application.

checks.name: Transport and API trust
checks.objective: Evaluate transport configuration and server-side authorization for mobile clients.

checks.name: Platform interaction
checks.objective: Review deep links, IPC, exported components and platform permission boundaries.

checks.name: Authentication and session handling
checks.objective: Assess local unlock, biometric use and server session lifecycle.

checks.name: Build and update integrity
checks.objective: Review signing, update provenance and release configuration.

checks.name: Authorized radios and access points
checks.objective: Record permitted wireless identifiers, locations and testing constraints.

checks.name: Network authentication and isolation
checks.objective: Review authentication modes and segmentation of wireless clients.

checks.name: Device enrollment and management
checks.objective: Assess onboarding, management access and device trust assumptions.

checks.name: Physical interface exposure
checks.objective: Document permitted console, removable media and device-access observations.

checks.name: Local storage and secret handling
checks.objective: Review local configuration, caches, logs and credential protection.

checks.name: IPC and privilege boundaries
checks.objective: Assess named pipes, local services and privileged operation authorization.

checks.name: Update and installer trust
checks.objective: Review package integrity, update verification and installation permissions.

checks.name: Remote communication and backend controls
checks.objective: Validate transport and backend authorization independently of the client.

checks.name: Rules of engagement and contacts
checks.objective: Record authorization, exclusions, windows, stop conditions and escalation contacts.

checks.name: Evidence handling and retention
checks.objective: Agree collection boundaries, custody, storage, reporting and deletion requirements.

checks.name: Detection validation
checks.objective: Coordinate agreed detection scenarios and record observed control responses.

checks.name: Reporting and quality review
checks.objective: Review finding reproducibility, severity rationale, affected scope and remediation.

checks.name: Retest and closure
checks.objective: Retest agreed fixes, reconcile unresolved risks and confirm cleanup.

checks.name: Operating constraints and system criticality
checks.objective: Record device roles, safety constraints, approved methods and maintenance windows.

checks.name: Management and protocol exposure
checks.objective: Inventory approved interfaces and document access-control observations.

checks.name: Firmware and update trust
checks.objective: Review available firmware provenance, update verification and recovery processes.

checks.name: Device secrets and trust boundaries
checks.objective: Review authorized evidence of credential storage and communication trust.

checks.name: Recovery and remediation feasibility
checks.objective: Assess agreed recovery steps and operational constraints on remediation.
